messages.content: The Monday dinner has moved from Ecco Midtown to Kimball House in Decatur and now starts at 6:00. Does the 2:05 airport arrival still work, or should I skip the Courtyard and go straight there?

The flight still leaves enough margin. Allow about 30-45 minutes to deplane and collect the checked bag, putting you at the curb around 2:35-2:50. A rideshare from ATL to the Courtyard could take 25-50 minutes, so hotel arrival is roughly 3:10-3:40. After check-in, Midtown to Decatur can take 25-50 minutes in late-afternoon traffic.
What departure time from the hotel would you use? I do not want the schedule to depend on unusually light traffic.

Leave the Courtyard by 4:40 p.m. That allows up to 50 minutes in traffic and still targets arrival around 5:30, with a 30-minute cushion before dinner. If the bag is delayed and you are not at the hotel by 3:50, reassess before checking in.
In that case, compare the fallback of going directly from the airport. I will have one rolling suitcase.

Going directly is the stronger timing fallback: leaving ATL around 2:50 would likely put you in Decatur around 3:20-4:00, well before dinner. The drawback is luggage. Kimball House does not advertise guest luggage storage, and a restaurant may have limited secure space, so that option should not be used without direct confirmation.
The Courtyard already agreed to store the suitcase on Wednesday. Does that cover Monday if the room is not ready?

No. Wednesday post-checkout storage does not confirm Monday pre-check-in handling. Ask the hotel specifically whether the front desk will accept and tag one suitcase on April 20 before the room is available. Also ask Kimball House whether it can securely hold one rolling suitcase during the 6:00 dinner, solely as a backup.
Settle the sequence for me, assuming the hotel confirms Monday storage but the restaurant does not.

Keep the scheduled airport arrival and stop at the Courtyard. Plan on landing at 2:05, reaching the curb by 2:35-2:50, and arriving at the hotel around 3:10-3:40. Check in if the room is ready; otherwise leave the tagged suitcase with the front desk. Depart by 4:40 for Kimball House and target 5:30 arrival. If you have not reached the hotel by 3:50, leave the bag there without waiting for the room and depart by 4:40. Do not take the suitcase to the restaurant without its explicit approval.
